host.linkage: static libxml2.a; otool -L check found no dynamic libxml2

build.loader_policy: deny-all per parser and schema context; no fallback
build.doctype_policy: SAX internalSubset callback immediately calls xmlStopParser
build.read_policy: descriptor callback; 4 KiB reads; 16 MiB cap plus one byte to detect excess

input_identity: Each deterministic generated or literal input is hashed byte-for-byte with CommonCrypto SHA-256 immediately before parsing; exact hashes and byte counts are in results.jsonl. No input XML is emitted.

expected_outcome_classes.reject: DOCTYPE, entity/resource declaration, malformed input, or candidate callback cap exceeded; no partial accepted result
expected_outcome_classes.accept_xml_layer_only: ordinary well-formed synthetic XML, including wrong namespace/version-like markup, schema hint, and inert XInclude marker
expected_outcome_classes.deny_resource: synthetic generic XSD include request rejected by schema-context deny-all loader

interpretation: Expected/observed values and exit statuses are recorded per case. Callback limits are not hard allocator/process limits. Measurements include the research harness and generated input. CPU worker is disposable research only.
